title: Reproducing 'inductive biases stick around': do early-training biases persist after fine-tuning?

original_idea.body:
# Do Early-Training Biases Persist After Fine-Tuning?

Pretrain a spurious bias, fine-tune with varying corrective data, measure re-emergence and overwrite cost.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: whether unsafe early biases survive safety fine-tuning directly bears on fine-tuning guarantees.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Small-model pretrain-then-finetune on synthetic data; clear methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused overwrite-cost measurement; breadth from pretraining setup.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: small models, synthetic data, one GPU, clear safety story.

low_compute.reasoning: Small models, synthetic data; pretraining adds cost.

novelty.reasoning: The claim is from a blog post; a clean controlled reproduction may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The persistence claim is informal; controlled reproduction may be open.
